rules: Receipt pass changes inventory evidence only and never changes connected-read, mutation, or execution authority.
Default disposition retain_frozen is not a long-term governance decision.
Advisory review may close review findings but cannot authorize a connected request.
Missing, stale, denied, ambiguous, over-cap, unpaginated, or uncustodied evidence yields incomplete.
The operator banner always displays the highest-precedence blocking state.
allowed_transitions: incomplete -> complete only after every receipt pass predicate is true
undecided -> retain_frozen or move_approved or replace_approved only through a separate owner decision

rules: Designated query identity is not an ownership claim and is not an exclusivity claim.
One project may be visible to multiple identities without being duplicated.
A visibility claim is current only when exact project ID, immutable project number, ancestry digest, identity, local configuration, and freshness are bound.
Account emails, billing IDs, credentials, and local configuration names stay outside Git.

invariants: Exactly four project IDs are in scope; no unlisted project may be discovered or queried.
Project identity is exact project ID plus immutable project number, never display name or account visibility.
Project-container nodes are neutral containers and do not inherit one child resource's environment role.
Multiple identity visibility claims for one project number do not create a duplicate-project recommendation.
Execution-control and preauth projects and databases remain physically distinct.
No bakeoff identity, store, or workload may reach production or staging.
Authority uniqueness applies per canonical resource role, not per multi-resource security domain.
Missing, denied, stale, ambiguous, partial, over-cap, or unpaginated visibility is incomplete.
No project creation, move, replacement, deletion, IAM change, API enablement, credential, workload, provider/PSTN, staging, production, or Task 4.8 action is permitted.
The mixed staging control plane is separate environment debt and is not repaired in Phase 0.5.

local configuration digest differs from the single-request envelope

a bound value or freshness window is stale

response exceeds field mask, page, byte, request, or time cap

parameter_binding_rules.EXACT_TARGET_PROJECT_NUMBER: fresh project_identity_get receipt bound to the same exact project ID
parameter_binding_rules.EXACT_ANCESTOR_FOLDER_NUMBER: one exact folder returned by the bound complete ancestry receipt
parameter_binding_rules.EXACT_ANCESTOR_ORGANIZATION_NUMBER: the exact organization returned by the bound complete ancestry receipt
parameter_binding_rules.EXACT_PROJECT_OR_ANCESTOR_ATTACHMENT_POI: the exact target project number or one exact bound ancestor, URL-encoded where the API requires it
parameter_binding_rules.EXACT_DETAILED_ASSET_TYPE_ALLOWLIST: the complete ordered exact_detailed_asset_type_allowlist without widening
parameter_binding_rules.EXACT_DATABASE_NAME_RETURNED_BY_ALLOWLIS: one exact name returned by firestore_database_list for the same target
parameter_binding_rules.EXACT_INSTANCE_NAME_RETURNED_BY_ALLOWLIS: one exact name returned by firebase_rtdb_instance_list for the same target
parameter_binding_rules.EXACT_DENY_POLICY_NAME_RETURNED_BY_ALLOW: one exact name returned by deny_policy_list for the same attachment point
parameter_binding_rules.EXACT_ENUMERATED_SERVICE_ACCOUNT: one exact account returned by service_account_list for the same target
parameter_binding_rules.EXACT_MATCHED_PREDEFINED_ROLE_NAME: one exact predefined role found in a bound allow-policy result
parameter_binding_rules.EXACT_MATCHED_ROLE_ID: one exact custom role ID found in a bound allow-policy result and same project or organization scope
parameter_binding_rules.EXACT_PAB_POLICY_NAME_RETURNED_BY_ALLOWL: one exact name returned by pab_policy_list for the bound organization
parameter_binding_rules.EACH_EXACT_ENUMERATED_CONSTRAINT: one exact name returned by org_policy_constraint_list for the same target
parameter_binding_rules.EXACT_OWNER_BOUND_MEMBER_QUERY: one of the exact future control principal, each owner-bound encompassing Resource Manager principal set, allUsers, or allAuthenticatedUsers
parameter_binding_rules.EXACT_OWNER_BOUND_EFFECTIVE_ACCESS_TUPLE: one exact principal-resource-permission tuple from effective_access_matrix
